guidance.statement: Double-digit volume growth target for CY2026, contingent on normal weather conditions
guidance.quote: double-digit growth in India is not impossible, and we would continue to stick to that

guidance.statement: India EBITDA margins guided at 22-23%, down from current 26% level
guidance.quote: our guidance has always been 22% - 23%, has never been higher than that

guidance.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margins target 21% and above on sustained basis
guidance.quote: we have always guided of consolidated margins at 21% and above

guidance.statement: South Africa to achieve 80% or higher growth with Twizza organic and inorganic capex
guidance.quote: we should see the growth of somewhere around 80% or higher in South Africa this year

guidance.statement: Snacks business expected to scale to approximately $100 million business opportunity
guidance.quote: We think this is going to go close to a $100 million business

guidance.statement: Snacks expected to deliver high-teens or higher growth rate going forward
guidance.quote: we expect at least high teens or even higher than that growth coming

guidance.statement: Rs. 10 price point restricted to 5-7% of portfolio, surgical selective launch only
guidance.quote: it will not be more than 5% - 7% of our portfolio

guidance.statement: Minimal capex in India, limited capex internationally mainly in South Africa
guidance.quote: we are not looking for any major CAPEX this year

delivered.statement: Consolidated volumes grew 7.9% to 1,213.1 million cases in CY2025
Q4 consolidated volumes up 10.2% to 237.1M cases; India +10.5%, international +10%
Revenue grew 8.4% to Rs. 216,853.8 million, adjusted for excise and GST
EBITDA increased 7.2% to Rs. 50,493.7 million; Q4 EBITDA up 10.2% to Rs. 6,392.6M
PAT grew 16.2% to Rs. 30,620.4 million; Q4 PAT up 32.9% to Rs. 2,600M
Low/no-sugar products reached 59% of consolidated volumes, up from prior year
India net debt-free with Rs. 12,250M free cash; consolidated net debt Rs. 256M only
CRISIL upgraded company's long-term credit rating to AAA/stable during CY2025

themes: Weather recovery opportunity - unprecedented rainfall ended, peak season volumes expected stronger
Capacity utilization focus - 20%+ capacity added, expected drive operating leverage CY2026
Product mix upgrade - low/no-sugar offerings increased to 59%, healthier portfolio priority
Distribution expansion - widening reach, visi-cooler deployment, strengthening supply chain efficiency
Strategic M&A and diversification - Twizza acquisition, snacks ramping, alcoholic beverages entry
Margin sustainability challenge - 26% current level versus 22-23% guided, volume dependent
risks: Weather dependency - unprecedented rainfall disrupted volumes; business is highly seasonal and volatile
Capacity utilization - added 20%+ capacity unable to absorb during weak CY2025 demand
Competitive discounting intensity - market-wide price discounting eroding realizations and margins
New plant startup costs - depreciation up 28.4%, recovery timeline remains uncertain
analyst_pushback: Volume-value gap 4.5%: Management attributed to discounting and pack upsizing in weak quarter
Margin sustainability at 26% all-time high: Maintained 22-23% realistic, 26% unsustainable level
Distribution metrics requested: Management declined citing competitive concerns, confirmed expansion occurred
Snacks timeline for $100M: Too early, Morocco only 6 months, Zimbabwe just started
tone_evidence: Confident on volume recovery and long-term potential, but cautious on margin sustainability levels
